detail.longDescription: Nothing like discovering your production crons never ran to motivate a migration. Two Laravel apps off cPanel onto Traefik, Docker Compose, Octane, FrankenPHP, Horizon, and Nightwatch. The old setup lied to me. The new one is boring and honest. https:// danielpetrica.com/a-production -ready-laravel-architecture-with-traefik-and-frankenphp/ # Laravel # PHP # OpenSource
